motions.item_title: Approve the minutes of August 25, 2026, Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Strong second…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to approve the minutes of August 25, 2026, Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: August 25 minutes approved
motions.summary: The commission approved the minutes of its August 25, 2026 meeting.
motions.impact: Approving the minutes makes the written record of the last meeting official. You will not notice any change.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Culinary Water Impact Fee Facility Plan (I…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Culinary Water Impact Fee Facility Plan (IFFP). Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Culinary water impact fee plan sent to council
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council adopt the culinary water impact fee facility plan, which lists the drinking water projects new growth must help pay for.
motions.impact: This is still only advice to the council, which decides later. The plan mostly matters to developers, since it underpins the water fee charged on new construction.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.B., Wastewater Master Plan and the Wastewater…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.B., Wastewater Master Plan and the Wastewater Impact Fee Facility Plan (IFFP). Commissioner DeCoursey seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Sewer master plan and impact fee plan sent to council
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council adopt a wastewater master plan and the facility plan used to set sewer impact fees on new development.
motions.impact: Nothing takes effect yet; the council has the final vote. If adopted, these plans guide future sewer projects and what builders of new homes pay toward them.
